rationale.campaign_length: 当前本地索引有48项A33直接任务，跨越多区域与时期。
rationale.colonization: 探险港、埃兰提尔据点及远洋任务构成长线核心。
rationale.complexity: 政治、海军、殖民、探险决议、魔法资源与巢穴需并行规划。
rationale.dark_story: 有反奴役、容忍和正义主题，也有征服与宗教改造，整体非黑暗主线。
rationale.difficulty: 长线花费与多战区经营较难，玩家帖亦报告早期资金紧。
rationale.diplomacy: 埃博蒂尔盟友、帝国选举、科琳教与殖民关系都要求外交经营。
rationale.early_pressure: 飞龙不在开局可用，早期需经济、山地与政治准备。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 飞龙驯养需法师支持，后期还有骑士、船只与奇械结合。
rationale.narrative_density: 王国旧梦、阿尔瓦改革、冒险、博览、飞龙与帝国理想层层推进。
rationale.tall_play: 首都博览馆、港口和巢穴建设重要，但最终需要跨洲行动。
rationale.trade_economy: 海湾港口、远洋航路和殖民贸易供给冒险与战争。
rationale.warfare: 飞龙神话骑兵、旧大陆对手与宗教政治战争提供战斗主轴。

identity.appearance: 1444年安本纳尔帝国内的弗恩人公国；主线保留A33，殖民属国可改名新弗恩

predecessors.relationship: 历史前身，不是同局起始Tag

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
随着龙醒事件一发不可收拾，弗恩人团结在阿莫克·弗尔恩身后，他是第一位驾驭飞龙的人，也是第一个被称为飞龙王的人。新生的弗恩王国迅速崛起，甚至能与威克斯的军阀和达梅里亚的堕落之月相抗衡。阿莫克·弗尔恩一世建立了伟大的遗产，一双深红的翅膀在月河上投下了阴影。

然而，所有崛起者都必将面临衰落，就像弗恩曾经超越的那些国家一样，它最终也被击败并被纳入达梅里亚霸权之下。弗恩现在已经不复往日光彩，飞龙骑士不再在天空中翱翔。深红色的翅膀消退到山脉之中，在残酷法师和贪婪偷猎者手中陷入灭绝边缘，只能由国家雇佣的弗恩冒险者队伍在赫纳克山脉范围内追捕潜在的偷猎者来确保其安全。但这并不意味着飞龙骑乘将永远成为过去的遗迹，因为一位领导弗恩的名君或许能将其恢复。

「我们的遗产是古老的，但并未被遗忘。弗恩、它的人民和它的公爵仍然梦想着过去的荣耀。但我们不会再做梦了。愿所有人都听从我的话，飞龙将再次在我们旗帜下飞翔，弗恩将再次崛起！」——阿尔瓦四世·西尔·弗恩——1461年
description.text_en:
As the Dragonwake unfolded, the Vernid people united behind Armoc Vernid, the first wyvern-rider and the first to bear the title of Wyvern-King. After its creation, the nascent kingdom rose high, even rivalling the warlords of Wex and the fallen moon of the Damerians. Armoc I Vernid built a great legacy, one of crimson wings casting their shadow along the Luna.

Yet, all that rise must fall, and much like the realms that Verne had eclipsed, it too was defeated and was brought under the Damerian hegemony. Verne has now lost its greatness, the wyvern-riders no longer scour the skies. The crimson wings have retreated to the mountains, on the brink of extinction at the hand of cruel arcanists and greedy poachers. Their protection ensured by teams of state-hired Vernmen adventurers, who hunt down would-be poachers all across the western Khenak range. But this does not mean wyvern-riding shall remain a relic of the past as it might yet be restored by the great men that lead Verne.

“Our legacy is old but not forgotten. Verne, its people and its Duke still dream of this past glory. But we will dream no longer. May all heed my words, wyverns will fly under our banners once more, and Verne shall rise !” - Alvar IV síl Verne - 1461

description.text:
弗恩和珍珠边地是势不两立的竞争对手，两国的海军野心相悖，都渴望在月神之首入口处占据主导地位。这种分歧已经演变成了一场持久的贸易战，其中船只往往以不友好的方式易手。因此，我们的商人和水手在「攻击性交换」商品（和弹药）方面有着丰富的经验。

在这场商业冲突中，珍珠边地有时会袭击并捕获弗恩的商船，以没收他们的货物。1425年，勇敢纳普斯湾船长安德烈设计了一种战术，以欺骗海盗并成功完成了一项重要的贸易任务。他用一艘装满一文不值的半腐烂龙虾的商船作为诱饵，而护航舰则装载着贵重货物。当珍珠边地海盗靠近时，那艘假商船投降了，而轻便快速的护航舰则看似逃跑实则成功完成了任务。尽管他这一举动没有事先报告上级或国王，但他所取得的巨大成功使他晋升为弗恩舰队的海军提督。

那次任务中的水手们把这个故事传遍了我们的港口，很快，「迟钝的龙虾」这个绰号就被加在了珍珠边地人身上，这种恶意的行为一直到今天仍被提及。
description.text_en:
Verne and Pearlsedge are the bitterest of rivals, their naval ambitions are at odds as both nations desire to assert their dominance on the entrance to the Dameshead. This disagreement has evolved into a permanent trade war, where ships often trade hands in less than amicable manner. As such our traders and sailors are quite experienced in “offensive exchange” of goods (and ammunition).

During this commercial conflict the Pearlsedger sometimes attacked and captured Vernmen trade ships to confiscate their goods. In 1425, the daring captain Andrel of Napesbay devised a tactic to deceive the corsairs and conduct an important trade mission successfully. He filled the trade ship with worthless half-rotten lobsters, while the escort ship contained the valuable cargo. When the Pearlsedger corsairs approached, the dummy trade ship surrendered while the light and fast escort seemingly fled and carried out its mission successfully. Even though this act was done without warning his superiors or the crown, the great success he achieved made him rise to the rank of admiral in charge of Verne’s fleets.

The sailors present on that mission spread the story across our ports and quickly the moniker “dull lobster” was attributed to the Pearlsedgers, an act of spite that is still mentioned to this day.

description.text:
随着埃兰提尔被重新发现，冒险的号角响彻坎诺，最伟大的冒险家们来到了这片陌生的土地，这里充满了强大的野兽和古老的秘密。其中最伟大的人就是弗恩人！

很快，冒险者城镇遍布大陆，从南到北，新大陆上出现了许多弗恩人。无论是深入危险的先驱精灵遗迹，还是挑战洇河领主，甚至是面对伊菲莱中心地带的黑暗，这些地方都是寻求新生活的人们的集结地。

按照弗恩人的传统，公国给予殖民地的支持不是通过恩惠或建议，而是通过伟大的功绩本身。正如阿尔瓦六世公爵在1553年所规定的那样，例如：

弗恩大胡子开启冒险之旅——国家赞助的装备
发现一处先驱精灵遗迹——该遗迹的财富与探险权
击沉一艘海盗船——指挥海军中的一艘战舰
征服一个敌对定居点——成为该定居点的总督
杀死一只伊菲莱巨兽——将军职位和以个人名义命名一个定居点

「这就是弗恩人的方式，让所有人见证伟人（和大胡子）。」——心园的厄宁关于胡子伟人理论的起源。
description.text_en:
As Aelantir was rediscovered and the call of adventure sounded across Cannor, the greatest adventurers came to a strange land, full of powerful beasts and ancient secrets. And among the greatest of these men were the Vernmen!

Soon, adventurer towns populated the continent, with many Vernmen cropping up across the new continent, from north to south. These were rallying points for those that sought a new life, whether that be to delve deep in dangerous precursor ruins, challenge the river lords of the Ynn and even facing the darkness deep in the heart of the Effe’lai.

And keeping with Vernmen tradition, colonial backing from the duchy was granted not by favour or proposals, but by great feats themselves. As established by Duke Alvar VI in 1553, such as:

A great mustachio - State sponsored equipment
Discovery of a precursor ruin - Funds and expedition rights for said ruin
Sinking a pirate ship - Command of a ship in the navy
Conquest of a rival settlement - Governorship of said settlement
Killing a great beast of the Effe’lai - Generalship and Naming of a settlement in one’s name

“Such is the way of the Vernmen, putting forth Great Men (and Great Mustachios) for all to witness.” - Erning of Heartspier on the origin of the Great Men Great Mustachios theory.

description.text:
弗恩青铜，许多人误认为是红铜，是一种自古以来只产于弗恩的特级青铜。它的品级通过加入只有在西部赫纳克才有的含铅量极低的锡实现。这使得弗恩青铜极为坚固，在军事工业中用途广泛。随着火药时代的到来，它的用途和价值进一步增加，因为它是大炮的理想金属。在弗恩，这种金属被用来生产一系列著名的大炮，通过特定的工艺，这些大炮的外表被染成深红色，并被称为「红铜大炮」。
这最终导致西尔·纳·铜翼家族创建了弗恩青铜与火炮商行，完全垄断了帝国的红铜出口。

有传言称，「红铜火炮」最初是被设计安装在双足飞龙身上，以实现可怕的游击战术。但这些努力（如果属实）从未取得成果。取而代之的是，现代双足飞龙骑兵使用「龙吼」弹药，将其从空中投下，在敌军队伍中散布恐怖气息，然后对敌军进行毁灭性的俯冲攻击。这种战术类似于埃博蒂尔海军的理论，即通过大炮的连续轰鸣来散布恐怖。
description.text_en:
Vernmen bronze, erroneously called Red-Brass by many, is a special grade of bronze solely produced in Verne since ancient times. Its grade is achieved by using very low lead content tin that is only found in the western Khenak. This makes Vernmen bronze extremely strong and highly adapted for many uses in the military industry. Its uses and value increased even further when the age of gunpowder came about as it was the perfect metal for cannons. In Verne, this metal is used to produce a famous line of cannons, coloured deep red on the exterior through a specific process and giving them the moniker “Red-Brass guns”.
This eventually led to the creation of the mercantile company Vernmen Bronze & Artillery by the síl na Bronzewing family, which had a complete monopoly on the export of Red-Brass in the Empire.

Rumours mention that the “Red-Brass guns” were initially designed to be mounted onto wyverns, enabling terrifying hit and run tactics. But these efforts, if true, never yielded results. Instead, the modern wyvern-riders use “wyvern-roar” ordinance, dropping them from the sky to spread terror in the enemy ranks before performing devastating diving attacks in the enemy ranks. This tactic is similar to the Eborthili naval doctrine of spreading terror through the continuous roar of cannons.

description.text:
1523年，第一届正式的双足飞龙之刺帆船赛举行，这是一场由双足飞龙湾沿岸众多港口的市长们组织的赛船比赛。从那时起，热血沸腾的年轻人和勇敢的水手们都会参加一年一度的比赛，比赛从守望者角出发，抵达斯汀港。这项赛事的路线十分危险，要绕过海湾和许多岩石小岛，最初是为了让水手们以友好的方式解决争端，因为在这条路上航行需要一定的技巧。

这项活动引起了国外水手的关注，1641年组织了有史以来第一次团体帆船赛，参赛队伍来自埃博蒂尔和安本科斯特。在随后的十年中，新的帆船赛在新的航线上举行，如游览特弗岛或月神之耳，甚至对于更有冒险精神的人来说，还可以从刺港前往埃哈。

随着经过刻伊俄奈、阿尔迪米娅和隐厦南部的南部海道的发现，一条新的航线正在规划中。这是一条环游世界的伟大航线，许多人称之为「大帆船赛」。
description.text_en:
In 1523 the first official Wyvern’s Sting Regatta was held, a boat race organised by the mayors of the many ports on the shores of the Wyvern’s Gulf. Since then, eager youngsters and hardy sailors alike take part in the yearly race, departing from Watchman’s Point and arriving in Stingport. The perilous course used for the event, going around the gulf and its many rocky islets, was initially used as a challenge for sailors to settle their disputes in friendly manners as navigating this path requires a modicum of skill.

The event caught the attention of sailors abroad, and in 1641 the first ever team regatta was organised, with teams hailing from Eborthil and Anbenncóst. In the following decade new regattas were established on new courses such as touring the Isle of Tef or the Damesear, and even, for the more adventurous, travelling from Strongport to Ekha.

With the discovery of a southern seaway passing by Kheionai, Ardimya and southern Insyaa, a new route is being planned. A grand course touring the globe for what many call “The Grand Regatta”.

description.text:
长期以来，安本纳尔一直是坎诺信仰的战场。1648年，随着《埃斯玛里亚和约》的签订，第一次科琳教战争宣告结束，允许任何坎诺人成为皇帝，无论他们是阿德恩信徒、科琳信徒，甚至是后来的揭秘教信徒。
因此，1648年，在和平之后，阿尔瓦一世·西尔·弗尔恩皇帝登基成为第一位科琳教皇帝。他在讲话中追溯了科琳教信仰在弗恩的起源，从勇敢兄弟的影响到阿多尔二世在1519年宣布皈依科琳教，他是深红洪水之前为数不多皈依科琳教的亲王之一。
阿尔瓦一世登基后宣布：「科琳教战争结束了！」

他错了。

在接下来的半个世纪里，帝国的统治权在弗恩人和他们永远的对手珍珠边地人之间易手。虽然在那段时期的大部分时间里，帝国以阴谋诡计和殖民地小冲突换取和平，但这却使科琳教信仰在安本纳尔本土根深蒂固，并表明人民不会再容忍暴政和腐朽。
1675年，第二次科琳教战争爆发，弗恩家族几近崩溃，直到他们邀请一位外国科琳教国王回家：卡米尔·席尔穆纳。
description.text_en:
Anbennar has long been the battleground of Cannorian faith, and in 1648 the First Corinite War was brought to an end with the Peace of Esmaria, allowing any Cannorian to become emperor, whether they be Adeanic, Corinite or even the new Ravelian faith.
And so in 1648, in the wake of peace, Emperor Alvar I síl Verne ascended the throne as the first Corinite Emperor. In his speech he retraced the faith's origins in Verne, from the influence of the Brave Brothers to Ardor II's declaration for Corinism in 1519, one of the few princes who converted before the Crimson Deluge.
Upon his ascension Alvar I declared: "The Corinite War has ended!"

He was wrong.

For the next half century the imperial seat switched hands between the Vernmen and their eternal rivals, the Pearlsedgers. Whilst for most of that period the empire traded peace for intrigue and colonial skirmishes, it entrenched the Corinite faith in Anbennar proper, and showed the people will not stand for tyranny and decadence any longer.
The bitter rivalry eventually sparked war once more, for there can be no peace whilst evil remained, and in 1675 the Second Corinite War saw the near-collapse of the House of Verne, that was, until they invited a foreign Corinite King to come home at least: Camir Silmuna.

description.text:
「我们的兄弟勇敢地前往东坎诺
在寒冷的渡汊，在湿透的帐篷里
队长悲痛欲绝
她砍倒了所有敌人

这就是弗恩之子
冒险是他的归宿
战斗激烈，迅速取胜
无论他去哪里

水手们肯定会去英勇角
盗贼也会畏惧他们的旗帜
带领巨魔湾的联合舰队
把海怪打得落花流水

这就是弗恩之子
冒险是他的归宿
战斗激烈，迅速取胜
无论他去哪里

我们的儿子自豪地踏上飞龙守卫的征程
在黑暗中寻找宝藏
他们在阿玛迪亚找到了爱的火花
他们找到了宝藏，欧！

这就是弗恩之子
冒险是他的归宿
他巧妙地赢得了少女的芳心
无论他走到哪里

许多伟人都是弗恩之子
冒险是弗恩人的归宿
髭须和肩膀都很强壮
我们的报酬不会低！」

——《弗恩之子》
作者不详，爱德华·艾伦-格威克松编译
description.text_en:
Ours brothers brave to Escann went
And in Athfork cold in sodden tent
The captain cried in grave lament
She'd hacked down every foe

Here is a Vernman’s son,
Adventure is where he belongs,
Battles fierce, swiftly won,
Wherever he shall go.

Sailors sure to Valorpoint
And thieves then fear their flags ahoist
And lead the Concords’ fleet conjoint
To blast sea monsters low.

Here is a Vernman’s son,
Adventure is where he belongs,
Battles fierce, swiftly won,
Wherever he shall go

To Drakesguard proud our sons embarked
To look for treasure in the dark
In Amadia they found loves’ spark
And treasures they sure found, oh!

Here is a Vernman’s son,
Adventure is where he belongs,
Maidens’ fair are deftly won,
Wherever he shall go

Many greats are Vernmen sons
Adventure’s home in Verne belongs,
Mustachios and shoulders strong,
Our pay will not be low!

Vernmen's Son
Unknown Author, Compiled by Edward Alen-Gerwicksson

player_overview.avoid_if: 想开局立即获得飞龙军队，或不喜欢多线经营与高资金门槛的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期改革与筹资，中期经营航路、殖民和冒险，后期培育飞龙骑士并争夺帝国与跨洲影响力。
player_overview.overview: 你从安本纳尔帝国的弗恩公国出发，凭港口、勇武传统和阿尔瓦的改革重整国家。先积累财力与魔法支持，再寻找飞龙蛋、建设巢穴，重建飞龙骑士；同时派探险队跨海寻找遗迹、扩建博览馆，并在科琳教与帝国政治中争取更大舞台。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢飞龙骑士、冒险故事、海军殖民和帝国内政的玩家。
signature_features: 失传飞龙骑术需要寻找飞龙蛋、建设巢穴和魔法准备才能恢复。
可通过决议派探险队前往远方，冒险收获进入博览馆。
海权殖民与科琳教帝国政治两条长线和飞龙军队交织。
player_overview.tagline: 让失传的飞龙骑士重返天空，把一个爱冒险的公国带向世界。

reasons: 飞龙骑士恢复过程比单纯领取骑兵加成更有叙事张力
指定地点探险与博览馆让殖民路线有故事收获
海权、信仰和帝国改革构成多线长期目标
warnings: 飞龙军队解锁较晚且依赖魔法准备
早期资金与任务前置门槛高于旧版印象
后期跨洲殖民、宗教和帝国政治需要并行管理

values.rationale: 永久废奴、提高对遗民容忍和反压迫主题是明确正面证据；殖民、战争与宗教改造主要降低克制，不再自动把国家压回中立。
